CustomField.label: Points Earned
CustomField.description: Loyalty points earned from this order, set once by LoyaltyService the moment Order_Tracking__c.Delivery_Status__c reaches Delivered (1 point per ₹1,000 of Taxable_Amount__c, whole-thousand rule) — never awarded earlier, since payment can still fail or the order can still be cancelled before then. See Feature Expansion Plan §2.3.
